title: Who is Jianxin? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 666 'Profile Reveal: Cleansing Reflections — Jianxin': a Taoist monk and successor of Fengyiquan; harnesses environmental Chi. Key art quote: 'I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?' Affiliation Jinzhou, Attribute Aero

Official news 666 lore images: Purity at Its Finest (her secret to conquering hardships and winning every battle: 'Just give it your all, and disregard the outcomes. Leave yourself no escape, and look death in the eye.'); Cleansing of Evil (asked to invoke an exorcism, she stammered and couldn't recall the incantation, then offered to help 'with martial arts'; after muffled groans, no more reports of demons); An Unique Performance (unable to find the perfect whistling leaf, she placed a strand of her hair between her lips and whistled a serene melody); A Different Approach (when cooking, she uses her Chi to adjust the heat); Protective Gear (practices every move three thousand times a day, regardless of the weather); Favorite Food (Guokui Flatbread; Master Shiling said she followed the scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how she joined the sect)
Five-star rarity: per the game's character listing
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: I am Jianxin, successor of Fengyiquan. Would you mind sparring with me? This is Jianxin, in Wuthering Waves.
Her secret to winning every battle? Give it your all, leave yourself no escape, and look death in the eye.
Once, someone begged her to exorcise demons. She forgot the incantation halfway, so she used her fists instead. No more demon reports since.
Her master taught her to whistle with a leaf. She couldn't find the right one, so she whistled with a strand of her own hair.
She practices every move three thousand times a day, in any weather. Even cooking is training: she uses her Chi to control the heat.
Her master jokes that as a child, she followed the scent of fresh flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how she joined the sect.
She's an Aero Resonator. So, would you spar with Jianxin? Tell me in the comments.
